jobs.title: FHIR Integration Engineer
jobs.description_text:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

jobs.description_text: WE DON’T DESIGN ONE-OFF PRODUCTS. WE DESIGN THE SYSTEM EVERY HOME IS BUILT FROM. We're rebuilding the housing system from the ground up, redesigning every aspect along the way. This isn't iteration — it's a full reinvention of how the world builds homes. Part of the broader ZURU Group, ZURU Tech has grown rapidly. We don't just improve the construction process — we're replacing it. Fueling that vision is a highly innovative, well-funded team moving at startup pace — with the resources and reach of a global company behind it. For more information, visit www.zurutech.com http://www.zuru.com Position Overview We're redesigning how homes are designed and built, and we're looking for an Industrial Designer to join our ZURU Tech Housing team in Los Angeles. You'll design the building components that make up a ZURU home and write the rules that decide how they fit together, so one system can be designed, manufactured and built anywhere in the world. jobs.title: Facilities Lead
jobs.description_text:
Be one of the Bedo 100

Albedo is making Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) mainstream, building the infrastructure to enable every satellite mission to enter this new orbital domain. We build buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions for customers to thrive in VLEO, below 300 km, where proximity compounds performance and drag self-cleans debris.
 
As part of the first 100 employees at Albedo, you will have a big impact on Albedo’s trajectory to proliferating VLEO — whether you’re advancing hardware to increase satellite longevity, scaling production for large constellations, building next-gen flight and ground software to push performance, or enabling missions that matter for national security and our day-to-day life here on Earth.
 
How We Operate: Albedo takes a first-principles approach — in space and in business. We move with speed, take calculated risks, and learn quickly. We use AI regularly to create leverage in every discipline across the company. We work in-person at our Broomfield, CO HQ to maximize team and company productivity. We work hard and with urgency to compound our first-mover advantage.

jobs.title: Configuration Manager 3
jobs.description_text:
Work Arrangement

This is an on-site position.

Job Overview

The Configuration Manager 3 will serve as an individual contributor, exercising administrative control over technical data and product configurations in various Configuration Management (CM) tools within the company. The focus of this role is to maintain rigorous and systematic coordination throughout the engineering and manufacturing of various aircraft products. This role serves as a key member of the Configuration and Data Management team; supporting strategic initiatives, process transformation efforts, tool administration, and day-to-day execution of CM activities.

Essential Functions

  • Lead configuration management activities across multiple products and programs, ensuring consistency, traceability, and compliance throughout the product lifecycle.

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy,

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning
jobs.description_text:
About Bot Auto

Bot Auto develops autonomous trucking technology. Our Simulation team builds software used to train and evaluate autonomous driving systems.

We are looking for a software engineer with C++ and CUDA experience to develop GPU-accelerated simulation software and improve reinforcement learning training efficiency. You will work with data, planning, and machine learning engineers on simulation and training infrastructure for autonomous trucking.

What You'll Do

  • Build GPU-accelerated simulation software for autonomous driving and reinforcement learning.
  • Improve the throughput of parallel simulation workloads and their integration with training workflows.
  • Profile simulation and training workloads, and optimize CPU and GPU execution, memory usage, and data transfer.
  • Develop tests and benchmarks to measure correctness, performance, and reproducibility.
  • Collaborate with data, planning, and machine learning engineers on implementation, design discussions, and code reviews.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

BrightAI is the physical AI company for the world's essential services. Water, power, oil and gas and industrial operators run aging assets with stretched crews and periodic inspections that miss problems as they develop. You'll set positioning and messaging for the company, products and use cases, then write much of what carries it: web pages, sales materials, case studies and editorial content. It's a hands-on writing role with strategic ownership, done in close partnership with growth and design.

Cartesian is building spatial intelligence for indoor environments to drive operational efficiency.
